# Achievement

> Achievement registry with saved unlocks.

- Package: `Achievement` · Category: Progression & live ops
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md), [Economy](Economy.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Achievement")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Achievement`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/AchievementSystem.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Achievement = GaxiaServer.Achievement
```

### Functions

- `Achievement.Register(def: AchievementDef): ()`
- `Achievement.Award(player: Player, id: string): boolean`
- `Achievement.IsUnlocked(player: Player, id: string): boolean`
- `Achievement.GetUnlocked(player: Player): { string }`
- `Achievement.Track(player: Player, eventType: string, ...: any): ()`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Achievement.OnUnlocked` — `Signal<Player, string, AchievementDef>`
  (player, id, def) once per player when an achievement unlocks (Award / Track)

### Types

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).

```lua
export type AchievementDef = {
    id: string,
    name: string,
    description: string,
    reward: { currency: string?, amount: number? }?,
    -- Optional condition: called by Track(); return true to auto-unlock.
    condition: ((player: Player, eventType: string, ...any) -> boolean)?,
}
```
